mechanism: Tranylcypromine is an irreversible MAOI that inhibits monoamine oxidase, and alcohol potentiates CNS depression while increasing risk of hypertensive crisis through accumulated tyramine metabolism and serotonergic effects.
action: Alcohol is absolutely contraindicated with tranylcypromine; patients must be counseled to avoid all alcoholic beverages including those with high tyramine content to prevent potentially life-threatening hypertensive episodes and severe CNS depression.
